partition_boundary.digital: The programmable integer-N feedback divider, design/divider/divider_intN.sch (netlist design/divider/netlist/divider_intN.spice), every gate of which is an instance of a sky130_fd_sc_hd standard cell. Hand-captured full-custom schematic: no RTL, no synthesis, no place-and-route.
partition_boundary.analog: Everything else: the ring-oscillator VCO (design/vco/vco_ring5.sch), the tri-state PFD and charge pump (design/pfd-cp/pfd_cp.sch), and the passive loop filter (design/loop-filter/loop_filter.sch).
